I reviewed my initial assessment against the Self-Reflection Checklist. 

1. Score-Reasoning Consistency: My scores align perfectly with the reasoning. Atom 0 (count) and Atom 5 (spatial) are correctly scored 0.0 due to definitive failures verified by both experts and visual inspection. All other atoms are 1.0 as they are fully satisfied.

The animal_pose_auditor provided detailed keypoint analysis confirming 5 instances but highlighting low confidence in hind limbs (supporting the anatomical defect note). The topology_boundary_auditor mask confirmed candle integrity but didn't override the missing wick observation.

The Router claimed this was true based on a weak interpretation ('right of the first two candles'). I independently verified the spatial layout and determined the guitars are actually IN FRONT of the candles, not to the right. This is a critical correction preventing leniency bias.

5. Harshness Bias: I avoided over-penalizing minor issues. The missing candle wicks and stylized flames are noted in authenticity but did not drop atom scores for presence/count/color since those specific attributes were still visually identifiable. The guitar taxonomy mismatch (acoustic vs electric) is documented as a defect but doesn't invalidate the 'are there guitars' or 'are they blue' atoms.

7. Upward Override Justification: I did NOT perform any upward overrides. In fact, I performed a DOWNWARD correction on Atom 5 (Router said True, I said False) based on independent visual evidence of the spatial arrangement. No positive verdicts were accepted without verification.
